minutes.headline: Planning Board denied a site plan waiver for the 1325 Mass Ave earth removal; bylaw forum drew heavy objections.
minutes.summary: The board denied the applicant's request to waive site plan review for an earth removal at 1325 Mass Ave and continued the stormwater hearing. A long public forum on the proposed earth removal bylaw drew objections to the threshold, setbacks and groundwater separation. The board voted to add the word native to the definition of earth, made Chapter 61 first-refusal recommendations, and discussed the stormwater bylaw.

public_comment.topic: Resident says the 1500 cubic yard threshold is too low and permit cost and length burden homeowners.
Question on how renewals of existing earth removal permits work under the new bylaw.
Contractor says offsets and setbacks are too restrictive for residential lots.
Contractor says the regulations are too many and should be simplified.
Resident urges a workable replacement because the current ten-yard bylaw is not being followed.
Suggests presenting the bylaw article separately from the regulations at Town Meeting.
Asks for formal input from town staff on how the current bylaw would be enforced if the new one fails.

votes.motion: Deny the waiver of site plan review for 1325 Mass Ave.
Continue the stormwater hearing for 1325 Mass Ave to March 23rd at 6:35.
Add the word native to the definition of earth in the bylaw.
Recommend the Selectmen not exercise first refusal on 322 Flat Hill Road.
Recommend not exercising first refusal on 57 and 63 Cross Road.
Send a letter to the Selectmen and landowner raising concerns about the Holman Street parcel, and involve Town Council.

budget_items.what_was_said: Speakers worried about permit and engineering costs for homeowners.
A member noted the board had held back on an additional request until progress was shown.

decisions.decision: Applicant to receive a bullet list of board concerns via the planner; site plan hearing set for April 13th.
Board will leave existing earth removal permits to the waiver process and keep the bylaw as is apart from adding native.
Stormwater bylaw will not go to this Town Meeting; two earth removal articles will be submitted without the regulations.
